content: Petero na Yohaana baheekwa embere z'akabuga k'aBayaahudi
Petero na Yohaana babeere bachiri bayigiriza olubaga, abadaahwa, omukulu w'abalanzi b'eNju ya Nnamahanga, n'aBasadukaayo baahulukira.
Abo bakulu bali bakalihire okubona Petero na Yohaana bali bayigiriza olubaga n'okubala oku obufuuke gurhenga omu bafu bubonekana kugerera Yeesu.
Babashweka n'okubahira omu munyororo kugera olusiku lwakulikiraga kwenge lyaliiri likola golo.
Aliko banene omu bayunvaga ezo nyigirizo bayemeera Yeesu. Oluganjo lw'abemeezi lwahikiira hoofu balume bihumbi birhaano.
Bwacheere eseezi, abakulu n'abashamuka b'aBayaahudi, n'abigiriza b'amarhegeko bachigusha eYerusaleema.
Baliiri haguma n'omudaahwa mukulu Hanaasi, Kayaafa, Yohaana, Alegizandere n'abandi bantu booshi baliiri b'omu mulala gw'omudaahwa mukulu.
Bamalire kuyimanza Petero na Yohaana ahagarhi kaabo, bababaza ntya: «Oku buhashe buchi changwa oku ziino lya nde mwajiraga ebyoola?»
Petero eyi ayunjwizwe Muuka-Mutagatiifu, ababwira ntya: «Ego mwe bakulu b'olubaga nenyu mwe bashamuka b'aBayaahudi,
rhubazizwe zeene elugulu w'amenja rhwajiriire echirema n'oku bulyo chafumyagwa.

Leero mwabo mweshi, n'olubaga looshi lw'eIsraheeli, mumenye bwinja: oyu muntu ayimangire embere zenyu n'amagala makwiriire oku ziino lya Yeesu Krisitu w'eNazareeti, olaala mwabambaga oku musalaaba, aliko Nnamahanga amufuula omu bafu.
Yeewe y'aMandiko Matagatiifu maderhere ko ntya:
Obuchunguke burhali omu windi muntu, kwenge nta lindi ziino omu gulu abantu bahaabirwe, lyagarhuchungwire.»

Abantu b'akabuga k'aBayaahudi babeere baabona Petero na Yohaana baderha n'oobushiru, basoomerwa, kwenge bali bayinji oku baliiri bantu konyine barhasomaga. Baanalimenyere oku boowe bo baliiri haguma na Yeesu.
Aliko, nk'okuula bali babwene olaala muntu bafumyaga ayimangire eburhambi bwabo, baabula echi bagashuba kuderha.
Baava babarhegeka oku barhange barhenge mw'ako kabuga. Bala bakulu boowe basigala omu mahwe.
Baabazana ntya: «Gurhe rhujirage abaala bantu? Bulaala abantu booshi b'eYerusaleema bayinji bwinja okw'echimenyeeso chabeere kugerera bo. Rhurhakanagala kugihakana.
Aliko y'omwazi gw'echoola chimenyeeso gurhayandaala bweneene omu lubaga, rhubakalihire oku barhachiderhaga n'omuntu n'omuguma elugulu w'eziino lya Yeesu.»
Baaja bahamagala Petero na Yohaana, banabarhegeka mpu barhachiderhaga changwa okuyigiriza chiro n'eliguma oku ziino lya Yeesu.
Aliko Petero na Yohaana babashubiza ntya: «Ka bikwaneene embere za Nnamahanga oku rhubakenge ahaali haage? Mugishogage,
kwenge rhwabo rhurhakagala kuleka kuderha ebintu rhwabwene ko rhwanayunva.»
Abantu b'akabuga k'aBayaahudi baashuba kubakalihira, banaja babalikuula. Barhaali babwene enjira y'okubahana, bulaala olubaga looshi lwaliiri lwakuuza Nnamahanga oku byooshi byabaaga.
Oyo muntu bajiriraga echoola kimenyeeso ch'ogufuma, aligwerhe myaaka minene ku makumi mane.
Abemeezi bahema Nnamahanga abakomeze
Babeere balikuulwa, Petero na Yohaana baaja kubalira abaabo byooshi abakulu b'abadaahwa n'abashamuka b'aBayaahudi bababwirire.
Bamalire kuyunva eyo myaazi, booshi basaliira Nnamahanga n'omurhima muguma. Baaderha ntya: «Nnaweerhu, wooyo we wajiraga echaalege, egulu n'enyanja, na byooshi biba omu byo.
Wooyo we waderhaga ntya kugerera Muuka-Mutagatiifu, omu buunu bwa shookuluza weerhu Daawudi, mukozi waawe:

content.text: yi balwisa Nnaweerhu Nnamahanga na Krisitu waage.›

content: Kwenge biri by'okuli oku Heroode na Ponsiyo Pilaato bayunvikeene muno gishagala haguma n'abarhali Bayaahudi n'olubaga lw'eIsraheeli kulahira Yeesu, omukozi waawe mutagatiifu, olaala wagishogaga.
Bajiraga ntyo, yi bayeeneza byooshi wabaaga warheganyize gurhenga miira oku buhashe bwawe n'emihigo yaawe.
Leero Nnaweerhu, olole bwinja obuhambaazi bwabo, ogaliise abaja baawe okubala eChinwa chaawe buzira buuba.
Ojaage walambuula okuboko kwawe y'abantu bafume, ebimenyeeso n'ebigiriginjo bibe kugerera eziino lya Yeesu, mukozi waawe mutagatiifu.»
Bamalire gusaliira, ahantu bali bachigushire hadirhimana bweneene, booshi bayunjula Muuka-Mutagatiifu. Barhondera kubala eChinwa cha Nnamahanga buzira buuba.
Abemeezi bagabana ebikulo byaabo
Abemeezi booshi baligwerhe omurhima muguma n'enkengeero nguma. Ntaaye waderhaga oku ebikulo byaage biri byaage yenyine, aliko bagendaga bashangiira byooshi bali bagwerhe.
Entumwa zaliiri zahamiiriza n'obuhashe bunene obufuuke bwa Nnaweerhu Yeesu, n'omugisho munene gwaliiri oku bo booshi.
Nta muguma omu bo walikeneere echintu, kwenge booshi bali bagwerhe amashwa changwa enju, bagendaga babiguza, banaleerha efuranga babiguzaga.
Bagendaga bahira zo embere z'eNtumwa, n'enyuma zanagabirwa ngasi muguma gukulikirana n'obulagiirire bwage.
Haliiri oMulaawi muguma oyirikwa Yozefu, aliiri muburhwa w'oku chizimba ch'eGipuro. Entumwa zamushembula eziino lya Baranaaba, kw'okuderha «Muntu okomeza abandi omurhima.»
Aguza eshwa aligwerhe, aleerha efuranga anazihira embere z'eNtumwa.
